notes.title: LEAPO FAITH 1.2: CONQUER THE TRIALS UPDATE
notes.content:
This is a much overdue update, I thank everyone that has already tried my silly little game!

In this update I added some new content in the form of a new mode called "CONQUER THE TRIALS". This content is to teach new users and struggling users new movement techniques to help them climb the tower! There are three levels, an easy level, a medium difficulty level, and an ultra hard level for users to hone in their skills and try to beat.

To my knowledge no one other than myself have climbed to the top of the tower, so do you have what it takes to be the first? Hopefully this new mode will help you all to beat the game!

Good luck and have fun :)
